component: mbox compaction temporary directory and source file state

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: GetOrCreateCompactionDir places .compact-temp beside the source, rejects an existing non-directory and uses a leading-dot name so it is not treated as a folder. MboxCompactor clones its source file object to avoid cached file-size state. Cleanup removes the temporary directory only non-recursively, because another folder may have recoverable files there. Scoped manual recommendation: preserve those directory/cleanup semantics; the separate .compacting/.compacted/.original suffix convention is already captured in existing knowledge. This is static source and test-code inspection at the frozen accepted revision. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remain pending; a landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.
title: The compaction temp directory must share the source filesystem and keep other recovery files
